nodes.norm_label: dsh engineering control plane plugin composition
nodes.rationale: Repository authority and verification policy are deployment-owned, so the bundle installs disabled rows that must not be activated until a complete Service configuration is supplied.

nodes.label: Mission-Owned Design Ledger
nodes.rationale: Keeping design provenance in Mission history avoids unaudited pre-Mission chat and a competing Proposal aggregate; simple Missions pay only for an empty Design Frontier.

nodes.label: mission_decide Dedicated Mission Tool
nodes.rationale: A dedicated revision-checked tool preserves structured, durable partial decisions and keeps mission_resume limited to operational recovery.

nodes.label: Plugin-Owned Mission Runtime
nodes.rationale: Harness Jobs have process-local or shared-unowned lifecycle semantics that do not match durable repository-authorized Missions, so the Control Plane must own cancellation and recovery.

nodes.label: Host-Derived Mission Authority
nodes.rationale: Authority is derived from the caller and host policy so model text cannot mint or replay a bearer capability, while Repository Identity prevents cross-repository control.

nodes.label: Quality Gate Decision Model
nodes.rationale: Separating definite engineering failure from untrustworthy Evidence preserves Rework as an engineering judgment and Blocked as a recoverable operational or governance state.

nodes.label: Stable Authority Roles
nodes.rationale: Stable Planner, Developer, Tester, and Reviewer authority preserves safety boundaries while Assurance Requirements allow specialized obligations without proliferating fixed role names.

nodes.label: Confirmed Testing Seams
nodes.rationale: Tests exercise behavior only through public interfaces so assurance does not couple to private Kernel implementation details.

nodes.label: Sealed External Assessments

nodes.label: Security Integration Proof

nodes.label: Submission Transport Integrity

nodes.label: Post-Implementation Subject

nodes.label: External Assessment Failure

nodes.label: Repository Binding
